title: hyperspectaculR: Artistic visualisation of hyperspectral imaging data
description: hyperspectaculR provides tools for loading, processing and creating artistic visualisations from hyperspectral imaging data, with particular support for recordings from TIVITA Suite systems. It generates three-dimensional spectral sculptures, animated band scans, RGB composites and abstract renderings derived from spectral structure, alongside conventional spectral analysis. The emphasis is on communication and outreach rather than quantitative measurement, turning spectral cubes into images intended for presentation and display.
